objective: Measure whether a historical extreme outside the current2025-2026 training range helps predict14deJulho discharge, without using the missing Muçum peak as a target.
training_scope: Local candidate only. Source clock, publication latency and pre-2024 operational regime remain limitations; no operational promotion.

new_rows.inputs: Q and I from14deJulho, MonteClaro and CastroAlves, in1000m3/s, plus1h difference and3h/6h slopes. Reproduce the24CERAN features of the frozen reference.
new_rows.clock: Preserve original ONS source clock with explicit assumedUTC-03. Apply60min assumed availability delay, matching frozen15h historical feature inputs. As-of input values expire after90min relative to the delayed lookup time; never interpolate.
new_rows.target: Exact published whole-hour14deJulho Q only. Exclude non-whole-hour23:59 timestamps from targets rather than silently shifting them to24h. Such readings may still be input history after the assumed delay.
new_rows.signs: Q must be finite and nonnegative; finite I may be negative perONS schema. Zero is retained. Missing values stay missing. Do not reject extremes or infer a9999 sentinel.
new_rows.other_sources: No invented rainfall or Carreiro measurements. Restrict both reduced-feature baselines and augmented candidate to the same24CERAN columns.

families: Reference ridge: frozen2025-2026 full feature set
Augmented ridge: same CERAN-only features plusSeptember2023 training rows
scoring: Preserve every original evaluation target across families. Report MAE, bias, P90 errors overall and above the unchanged2025 pre-validation95th-percentile threshold. No hyperparameter search or tuning from the development test.
known_limitations: September2023 has already been inspected; adding it to training cannot be described as validation on an unseen event.
July-September2026 is an inspected development period, not independent validation.
ONS rows are agent-reported and not independently validated by ONS.
Pre-2024 barrage regimes may differ from current operation; improvement must survive independent future events.
Reduced-feature comparison is needed to separate additional history from removal of rainfall and tributary predictors.
